caption: Jo aurat aaj apne kharche khud utha rahi hai... woh kabhi kisi ki “Papa ki Pari” bhi thi. ❤️Kabhi uski har zarurat bina kahe poori ho jaati thi.Aaj woh khud apni zimmedariyan utha rahi hai.Log kehte hain,“Tum bahut strong ho gayi ho.”Lekin har strength ke peeche ek kahani hoti hai.Kai baar zindagi humein majboor karti hai ki hum har role khud nibhayein.Agar tum uski softness, uski feminine side dekhna chahte ho...To usse support do.Use emotionally safe feel karao.Har baar sirf yeh mat keh do—“Aisa toh sabke saath hota hai.”Kabhi kabhi ek insaan ko solution se pehle sirf yeh sunne ki zarurat hoti hai:“Main hoon. Tum akeli nahi ho.” 🤍Strength is admirable.But support is what allows people to soften.
